as_told.title: Carl Sagan calls Brandenburg about his Mars claims

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on a story about a man named John Brandenburg, who had done something that stirred up controversy about the Moon or space. Michels says that the famous astronomer Carl Sagan, of all people, phoned Brandenburg and asked him, "Why are you causing this trouble?" Michels tells it to suggest that even leading scientists were uneasy about the questions Brandenburg was raising.
